scripts.title: Jade World
scripts.features: This script makes your dead rails be JADE
scripts.script:
while true do
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.Material = Enum.Material.Foil
            obj.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 128, 0)
        elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
            if not string.find(obj.Text, "Jade") then
                obj.Text = "Jade " .. obj.Text
            end
        end
    end
    wait(1)
end
